description: Returns a pseudonymous channel descriptor {descriptor, witness:{ts}}; the 3.3 KB ML-DSA signature and the handle-ownership proof come as separate parts (part=sig | part=proof) because they cannot share one 8 KiB lane reply. Verify all three locally (SDK voidVerifyDescriptor) before following. Private-lane-only (a direct lookup would tell the gateway which channel your IP wants): use the stdio door.

part.description: omit for the descriptor, or sig / proof
